Keep the better reroll for Search Your Feelings or Sense Force.

Rage once per day: +2 melee attack and damage for 5 + CON modifier rounds, then a persistent condition step.
Intimidation rerolls must use the new result. Bowcaster counts as rifles; Ryyk blade as advanced melee.

feats.name: Armor Proficiency (Light)
feats.reminder: Remove light armor penalties and enable its equipment bonuses.

feats.name: Armor Proficiency (Medium)
feats.reminder: Remove medium armor penalties and enable its equipment bonuses.

feats.name: Armor Proficiency (Heavy)
feats.reminder: Remove heavy armor penalties and enable its equipment bonuses.

feats.name: Dodge
feats.reminder: +1 Reflex against a chosen opponent while you retain your Dexterity bonus.

feats.name: Force Sensitivity
feats.reminder: Use the Force becomes available and a class skill. Force talent trees become available when imported.

feats.name: Improved Damage Threshold
feats.reminder: Damage threshold increases by 5.

feats.name: Improved Defenses
feats.reminder: All three defenses increase by 1.

feats.name: Linguist
feats.reminder: Learn 1 + INT modifier additional languages, minimum 1, per selection.

feats.name: Point-Blank Shot
feats.reminder: +1 ranged attack and damage within point-blank range; apply with attack modifiers.

feats.name: Precise Shot
feats.reminder: Remove the ranged attack penalty for firing into melee.

feats.name: Shake It Off
feats.reminder: Recover one condition step with two swift actions.

feats.name: Skill Focus
feats.reminder: Gain +5 competence to the chosen trained skill.

feats.name: Skill Training
feats.reminder: Train one additional class skill.

feats.name: Toughness
feats.reminder: Gain 1 HP per heroic level.

feats.name: Weapon Focus
feats.reminder: +1 attack with the chosen weapon group.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (Lightsabers)
feats.reminder: Proficiency with lightsabers.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (Pistols)
feats.reminder: Proficiency with pistols.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (Rifles)
feats.reminder: Proficiency with rifles.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (Simple Weapons)
feats.reminder: Proficiency with simple weapons.

feats.name: Acrobatic Strike
feats.reminder: Effect: If you succeed in Tumbling to avoid an Attack of Opportunity, you gain a +2 competence bonus on the next attack roll you make against that foe as long as the attack occurs before the end of your current turn.

feats.name: Careful Shot
feats.reminder: Effect: If you Aim before making a Ranged Attack, you gain a +1 bonus on your attack roll.

feats.name: Charging Fire
feats.reminder: Effect: When you Charge, you may make a Ranged Attack instead of a Melee Attack at the end of your movement. Unlike a normal Charge, your momentum does not help you overcome your target, so you gain no bonus on your attack roll. As with a normal Charge, you still take a -2 penalty to your Reflex Defense.

feats.name: Combat Reflexes
feats.reminder: Effect: When opponents leave themselves open, you may make a number of additional Attacks of Opportunity equal to your Dexterity modifier.

feats.name: Coordinated Attack
feats.reminder: Effect: You are automatically successful when using the Aid Another Action to aid an ally's attack, or Suppress an Enemy as long as the target is adjacent to you or within Point-Blank Range.

feats.name: Quick Draw
feats.reminder: Effect: You can Draw or Holster a Weapon as a Swift Action instead of a Move Action.

feats.name: Rapid Shot
feats.reminder: Effect: When using a ranged weapon with which you are proficient, you may fire two shots as a single attack against a single target. You take a -2 penalty on your attack roll, but you deal +1 die of damage with a successful attack. This feat works normally with Vehicle Weapons. However, if you are using Missiles or Torpedoes and you miss with your attack roll, the projectile does not gain the benefit of this feat for the second attack roll.

feats.name: Rapid Strike
feats.reminder: Effect: When using a melee weapon with which you are proficient, you may make two strikes as a single attack against a single target. You take a -2 penalty on your attack roll, but deal +1 die of damage with a successful attack.

feats.name: Running Attack
feats.reminder: Effect: When making an attack with a melee or ranged weapon, you can Move both before and after the attack, provided that the total distance moved is not greater than your Speed.

feats.name: Vehicular Combat
feats.reminder: Effect: Once per round (as a Reaction), when you are Piloting a Vehicle or Starship, you may negate a weapon hit by making a successful Pilot check. The DC of the Skill Check is equal to the result of the attack roll you wish to negate. In addition, while you are Piloting a Vehicle, you are considered proficient with Pilot-operated Vehicle Weapons.

talents.name: Acute Senses
talents.reminder: Perception rerolls must use the new result. Also applies to Use Sensors.

talents.name: Armored Defense
talents.reminder: With proficient armor, use the higher of armor bonus and heroic level for Reflex.

talents.name: Block
talents.reminder: React with Use the Force against a melee attack; each additional Block/Deflect adds a cumulative -5. An ignited lightsaber is required.

talents.name: Born Leader
talents.reminder: Once per encounter, allies in sight gain +1 insight to attacks while they remain in sight.

talents.name: Deflect
talents.reminder: React with Use the Force against a ranged attack; each additional Block/Deflect adds a cumulative -5. An ignited lightsaber is required.

talents.name: Evasion
talents.reminder: Area attacks deal half damage on a hit and none on a miss.

talents.name: Fool's Luck
talents.reminder: Spend a standard action and Force Point: +1 competence to attacks or defenses, or +5 competence to skills, for the encounter.

talents.name: Improved Armored Defense
talents.reminder: With proficient armor, use the higher of armor bonus and heroic level + half armor bonus.

talents.name: Improved Initiative
talents.reminder: Initiative rerolls must use the new result.

talents.name: Inspire Confidence
talents.reminder: Use a standard action to grant allies in sight +1 morale to attacks and skills for the encounter.

talents.name: Knack
talents.reminder: Once per day per selection, reroll a skill check and keep the better roll.

talents.name: Skilled Advisor
talents.reminder: Spend a full-round action to advise an ally: +5 to their next skill check, or +10 with a Force Point.

talents.name: Sneak Attack
talents.reminder: Add 1d6 per selection against targets denied Dexterity; ranged attacks require a target within 6 squares.

talents.name: Wealth
talents.reminder: On each level gained after selection, including the selection level, receive 5,000 × Noble class level credits. Record income in your credit balance.

talents.name: Weapon Specialization
talents.reminder: +2 damage with the chosen weapon group.

talents.name: Hidden Movement
talents.reminder: You're very good at hiding when mobile. You take no penalty on your Stealth check when moving your normal Speed. This Talent applies to Stealth checks made while Piloting a Starship (see Starship Stealth).

talents.name: Improved Stealth
talents.reminder: You may choose to reroll any Stealth check, but the result of the reroll must be accepted, even if it is worse. This Talent applies to Stealth checks made while Piloting a Starship (see Starship Stealth).

talents.name: Improved Concealment
talents.reminder: Any situation that would give you Concealment grants you Total Concealment instead.

talents.name: Barter
talents.reminder: You may reroll any Persuasion check made to Haggle, but the result of the reroll must be accepted, even if it is worse.

talents.name: Fringe Savant
talents.reminder: Whenever you roll a Natural 20 on a Skill Check during an encounter, you gain one temporary Force Point. If the Force Point is not used before the end of the encounter, it is lost.

talents.name: Long Stride
talents.reminder: Your Speed increases by 2 squares if you are wearing Light Armor or no armor. If you have a natural Fly, Climb, or Swim speed, it increases by 2 squares as well. You cannot use this Talent if you are wearing Medium Armor or Heavy Armor.

talents.name: Jury-Rigger
talents.reminder: You may reroll any Mechanics check made to Jury-Rig, but the result of the reroll must be accepted, even if it is worse.

talents.name: Extreme Effort
talents.reminder: You can spend two Swift Actions to gain a +5 bonus on a single Strength check or Strength-based Skill Check made during the same round.

talents.name: Sprint
talents.reminder: When you use the Run Action, you can move up to five times your Speed (instead of up to four times).

talents.name: Surefooted
talents.reminder: Your Speed is not reduced by Difficult Terrain.

talents.name: Armor Mastery
talents.reminder: The maximum Dexterity bonus of your armor improves by +1. You must be proficient with the armor you are wearing to gain this benefit.

talents.name: Juggernaut
talents.reminder: Your armor does not reduce your Speed or the distance you can move while Running. You must be proficient with the armor you are wearing to gain this benefit.

talents.name: Second Skin
talents.reminder: When wearing armor with which you are proficient, your Armor bonus to your Reflex Defense and Equipment bonus to your Fortitude Defense each increases by +1.

talents.name: Expert Grappler
talents.reminder: You gain a +2 competence bonus on Grapple attacks.

talents.name: Gun Club
talents.reminder: You can use a ranged weapon as a melee weapon without taking a penalty on your attack roll. The weapon is otherwise treated as a Club in all respects. If you are using a Rifle with a mounted Bayonet or Vibrobayonet, you may wield that weapon as a Double Weapon. The Bayonet or Vibrobayonet end is treated normally, and the other end is treated as a Club.

talents.name: Melee Smash
talents.reminder: You deal +1 point of damage with Melee Attacks.

talents.name: Stunning Strike
talents.reminder: When you damage an opponent with a Melee Attack, your opponent moves an additional -1 step along the Condition Track if your damage roll result equals or exceeds the target's Damage Threshold.

talents.name: Unbalance Opponent
talents.reminder: You are skilled at keeping your opponents off balance in melee combat. At the beginning of your turn, you can choose to designate an opponent no more than one size category larger or smaller than you. That opponent doesn't get to add their Strength bonus on attack rolls when targeting you (if the opponent has a Strength penalty, they still suffer from that penalty). The opponent's Strength modifier applies to damage, as usual. You can select a new opponent on your next turn.

talents.name: Battle Analysis
talents.reminder: As a Swift Action, you can make a DC 15 Knowledge (Tactics) check. If the check succeeds, you know which allies and opponents in your line of sight are reduced to at least half of their maximum total Hit Points. If you succeed at both a DC 15 Knowledge (Tactics) check and a DC 15 Use Computer check, you may use this Talent to determine what Vehicles are reduced to at least half their maximum Hit Points.

talents.name: Cover Fire
talents.reminder: When you make a Ranged Attack with a Pistol or Rifle, all allies within 6 squares of you when you made the attack gain a +1 bonus to Reflex Defense until the start of your next turn. Allies within range don't need to be within your line of sight to gain the bonus.

talents.name: Demolitionist
talents.reminder: When you use the Mechanics skill to Handle Explosives, the explosion deals +2 dice of damage. You may take this Talent multiple times; its effects stack.

talents.name: Draw Fire
talents.reminder:
You can distract opponents and convince them that you are the most tempting (or most dangerous) target in the area. As a Swift Action, make a Persuasion check and compare the result to the Will Defense of all opponents within line of sight. If the check result exceeds an opponent's Will Defense, that opponent cannot attack any character within 6 squares of you until the start of your next turn as long as you do not have Cover against that opponent. (The affected opponent may still attack you, however.)

If you are a Vehicle Pilot, you may use this Talent to protect allied Vehicles. You may use it to protect Vehicles no more than one size category larger than your own.

talents.name: Harm's Way
talents.reminder:
Once per round, you may spend a Swift Action to shield a single adjacent ally from attacks, taking the damage and suffering the ill effects in your ally's stead. Until the start of your next turn, any attack made against the protected ally targets you instead. You may elect not to shield your protected ally against a given attack, provided the decision is made before the attack roll is made.

If you are a Vehicle Pilot, you may use this Talent to protect allied Vehicles. You may use it to protect Vehicles no more than one size category larger than your own.

talents.name: Indomitable
talents.reminder: Once per day as a Swift Action, you can move +5 steps on the Condition Track. This does not remove any Persistent Conditions that may be affecting you. This Talent does not affect the Condition Track of a Vehicle. You can select this talent multiple times. Each time you select this Talent, you can use it one additional time per day.

talents.name: Tough as Nails
talents.reminder: You can catch a Second Wind one extra time per day. If you have this Talent and the Extra Second Wind feat, you can catch your Second Wind a total of three times per day.

talents.name: Devastating Attack
talents.reminder: Choose a single Exotic Weapon or Weapon Group with which you are proficient. Whenever you make a successful attack against a target using such a weapon, you treat your target's Damage Threshold as if it were 5 points lower when determining the result of your attack. If you select Heavy Weapons as the Weapon Group this Talent applies to, you may also use the Talent with Vehicle Weapon attacks. You may select this Talent multiple times. Each time you select this Talent, it applies to a different Exotic Weapon or Weapon Group.

talents.name: Penetrating Attack
talents.reminder: Choose a single Exotic Weapon or Weapon Group with which you are proficient. Whenever you make a successful attack against a target with such a weapon, you treat your target's Damage Reduction as if it were 5 points lower when determining the result of your attack. If you select Heavy Weapons as the Weapon Group this Talent applies to, you may also use the Talent with Vehicle Weapon attacks. You may select this Talent multiple times. Each time you select this Talent, it applies to a different Exotic Weapon or Weapon Group.

reference.heading: Destiny
reference.text: Your Destiny requires you to become the leader of a large and/or significant group or organization and successfully lead it through an extremely threatening event.

reference.heading: Destiny Bonus
reference.text: For 24 hours, you and any allies within 10 squares of you gain a +1 Destiny bonus to all Defenses.

reference.heading: Destiny Penalty
reference.text: You take a -2 penalty to all your Defenses for 24 hours.

reference.heading: Destiny Fulfilled
reference.text: You receive a permanent +2 increase to your Charisma score.

reference.heading: Destiny
reference.text: Your Destiny is to corrupt an individual, organization, or location.

reference.heading: Destiny Bonus
reference.text: For 24 hours, you and any allies within 10 squares of you gain a +1 Destiny bonus on Skill Checks and Ability Checks.

reference.heading: Destiny Penalty
reference.text: You take a -2 penalty on all Skill Checks and Ability Checks for 24 hours.

reference.heading: Destiny Fulfilled
reference.text: Increase two Ability Scores of your choice by +1 each. In addition, if your Dark Side Score is less than your Wisdom score, your Dark Side Score increases until it's equal to your Wisdom score signifying that you've turned to The Dark Side.

reference.heading: Destiny
reference.text: Your Destiny requires you to create an object, machine, or other item of great power or significant use.

reference.heading: Destiny Bonus
reference.text: For 24 hours, you and any allies within 10 squares of you gain a +1 Destiny bonus on Skill Checks and Ability Checks.

reference.heading: Destiny Penalty
reference.text: You take a -2 penalty on Skill Checks and Ability Checks for 24 hours.

reference.heading: Destiny Fulfilled
reference.text: You or any ally within Line of Sight can spend 2 Force Points in a single round while performing an action using the created object.

reference.heading: Destiny
reference.text: Your Destiny is to destroy a person or object, for good or evil.

reference.heading: Destiny Bonus
reference.text: For 24 hours, you and any allies within 10 squares of you gain a +2 Destiny bonus on all damage rolls.

reference.heading: Destiny Penalty
reference.text: You take a -2 penalty on all damage rolls for 24 hours.

reference.heading: Destiny Fulfilled
reference.text: Increase one Ability Score of your choice by +2.

reference.heading: Destiny
reference.text: Your Destiny is to discover a Species, person, object, or location that was either previously lost or unknown to the civilized galaxy.

reference.heading: Destiny Bonus
reference.text: For 24 hours, you and any ally within 10 squares of you gain a +1 Destiny bonus to all Defenses (Reflex, Fortitude, and Will).

reference.heading: Destiny Penalty
reference.text: You take a -1 penalty to your Defenses (Reflex, Fortitude, and Will) for 24 hours.

reference.heading: Destiny Fulfilled
reference.text: You gain a permanent +1 Destiny bonus to your Defenses (Reflex, Fortitude, and Will).

reference.heading: Destiny
reference.text: Your Destiny is to train or educate another being or group of beings in some way.

reference.heading: Destiny Bonus
reference.text: For 24 hours, you and any allies within 10 squares of you gain a +1 Destiny bonus on Skill Checks and Ability Checks.

reference.heading: Destiny Penalty
reference.text: You take a -2 penalty on all Skill Checks and Ability Checks for 24 hours.

reference.heading: Destiny Fulfilled
reference.text: You gain a permanent +5 Destiny bonus on checks made with one Class Skill of your choice.

reference.heading: Destiny
reference.text: Your Destiny is to liberate a group, population, or region from domination.

reference.heading: Destiny Bonus
reference.text: For 24 hours, you and any allies within 10 squares of you gain a +2 Destiny bonus on Damage rolls.

reference.heading: Destiny Penalty
reference.text: You take a -2 penalty on Damage rolls for 24 hours.

reference.heading: Destiny Fulfilled
reference.text: You gain a permanent +1 Destiny bonus to all your Defenses.

reference.heading: Destiny
reference.text: Your Destiny is to redeem a character that has been corrupted or otherwise turned to evil. Many Jedi seek to turn their fallen brethren away from The Dark Side.

reference.heading: Destiny Bonus
reference.text: You gain a Force Point.

reference.heading: Destiny Penalty
reference.text: You lose one Force Point. If you have no Force Points to lose, you take a -1 penalty on attack rolls until you gain a level.

reference.heading: Destiny Fulfilled
reference.text: The Dark Side Score of the Redeemed character is reduced to 1, and they lose any remaining Force Points. You gain a number of Force Points equal to 3 + the number of Force Points the Redeemed character lost.

reference.heading: Destiny
reference.text: Your Destiny requires you to save a person from death or an object from destruction.

reference.heading: Destiny Bonus
reference.text: For 24 hours, you and any allies within 10 squares of you gain a +2 Destiny bonus on all damage rolls.

reference.heading: Destiny Penalty
reference.text: You take a -2 penalty on all damage rolls for 24 hours.

reference.heading: Destiny Fulfilled
reference.text: Increase two Ability Scores of your choice by +1 each.

destinies.name: We've Been Through a Lot Together

reference.heading: Destiny Points
reference.text: Automatically cause an attack rolled against your Starship to miss, even once the attack is resolved. (Commander, Copilot, or Vehicle Pilot only)

reference.heading: Destiny Points
reference.text: Automatically succeed on any Pilot check, including any check to avoid a hazard or obstacle, getting the best possible outcome on the check. (Vehicle Pilot or Copilot only)

reference.heading: Destiny Points
reference.text: Allow your Starship to act out of turn, thus changing your position in the Initiative Order. (Vehicle Pilot, Commander, or System Operator only)

reference.heading: Destiny Points
reference.text: Cause any damage rolled against your Starship to instead affect any other Starship within three squares. (Vehicle Pilot, Commander, or System Operator only)

reference.heading: Destiny Points
reference.text: Move your Starship to the top of its Condition Track. If any systems have been disabled because of being moved down your Condition Track, they now function. (Engineer only)

reference.heading: Destiny Points
reference.text: Repair your Starship, restoring a number of Hit Points equal to its Damage Threshold. (Engineer only)

reference.heading: Destiny Points
reference.text: Restore your Starship's shields to full Shield Rating. (Engineer or System Operator only)

reference.heading: Destiny Points
reference.text: If you are using Starship Maneuvers, you can spend a Destiny Point to regain all uses of all your maneuvers. (Vehicle Pilot or Gunner only)

reference.heading: Occupation
reference.text: When you select an Occupation Background, add one of the relevant Skills listed at the end of that entry to your list of Class Skills, regardless of your starting Heroic Class. Your chosen Skill represents something your character learned to do as a result of his or her Occupation. Additionally, you gain a +2 competence bonus to Untrained skill checks with the Skills in your Occupation's list of relevant Skills.

reference.heading: Enhancement
reference.text: As a result of your loss, you have learned to search diligently, either for those responsible for the death of your loved one or for those who might know his or her current whereabouts. You can Take 20 on Gather Information checks, but it takes 20 times as long as normal to gain the information.
